papers.paper: STA 201/202/204 quiz (2024/2025 session), an online multiple-choice quiz
papers.source: STA 201_202_204 quiz (2024_2025 SESSION).pdf (a student's screenshots; their details are not copied, and two items that rely on a figure are left out)

questions.text: Association is a measure of the strength of the relationship between ______. (Attributes / Variables / None of these options / Constants)
If Chi sq = 5.8 and degree of freedom = 1, we make the following decision ______. (We accept H0 at α = 0.05 / We reject H1 at α = 0.05 / We reject H0 at α = 0.01 / We reject H0 at α = 0.05)
If the quartile range is 24 then the quartile deviation is ______. (48 / 12 / 24 / 72)
Let A and B be two events such that P(A) = 1/5 while P(A or B) = 1/2. Let P(B) = P. For what values of P are A and B independent? (1/10 and 3/10 / 3/10 and 4/5 / 3/8 only / 3/10)
Calculate the mean number of children per family for the sample from the following table. (The table is not shown in the copy.) (1.91 / 2.47 / 3.14 / 2.19)

Considering the sample statistic, if the mean of sampling distribution is equal to population mean then the sample statistic is classified as ______. (unbiased estimator / biased estimator / interval estimator / hypothesis estimator)

The type of stratified proportion sampling in which the information is gathered on convenience basis from different groups of population is classified as ______. (purposive sampling / judgment sampling / quota sampling / convenience sampling)

The distribution of heights of American women aged 18 to 24 is approximately normally distributed with a mean of 65.5 inches and standard deviation of 2.5 inches. Calculate the z-score for a woman six feet tall. (2.60 / 4.11 / 1.04 / 1.33)
The formula to calculate standardized normal random variable is ______. ((x − μ)/σ / (x + μ)/σ / (x − σ)/μ / (x + σ)/μ)
A statistic is: (a sample characteristic / a population characteristic / unknown / normally distributed)
In a sample space S, if P(A) = 0, then A is independent of any other event. (True / False)

The range or set of values which have chances to contain value of population parameter with particular confidence level is considered as ______. (secondary interval estimation / confidence interval estimate / population interval estimate / sample interval estimate)

When the correlation coefficient, r, is close to one: (there is no relationship between the two variables / there is a strong linear relationship between the two variables / it is impossible to tell if there is a relationship between the two variables / the slope of the regression line will be close to one)

The probability of second event in the situation if the first event has been occurred is classified as ______. (series probability / conditional probability / joint probability / dependent probability)

In the two units of company, the employees in unit one are 650 and monthly salary is N2750, the employees in unit two are 700 and monthly salary is N2500 then the combined arithmetic mean is ______. (N2,620 / N2,520 / N2,420 / N2,320)
At a manufacturing plant, the unit of quantity manufactured in 8 days are 250, 320, 240, 210, 260, 330, 310, 260. What is the median quantity produced? (210 / 260 / 240 / 250)
In 1923, Badejoko Ruth had 522 at bats with 205 hits. Assuming that the binomial distribution can be appropriately applied, find the expected number of hits in 529 at bats. (321 / 186 / 230 / 208)

Let A and B be two events such that the occurrence of A implies occurrence of B, but not vice-versa, then the correct relation between P(A) and P(B) is? (P(A) < P(B) / P(B) ≥ P(A) / P(A) = P(B) / P(A) ≥ P(B))

A national random sample of 20 ACT scores from 2010 is listed below. Calculate the sample mean and standard deviation. 29, 26, 13, 23, 23, 25, 17, 22, 17, 19, 12, 26, 30, 30, 18, 14, 12, 26, 17, 18. (20.50, 5.79 / 20.50, 5.94 / 20.85, 5.79 / 20.85, 5.94)
A parameter is: (a sample characteristic / a population characteristic / unknown / normally distributed)
Given IQ scores are approximately normally distributed with a mean of 100 and standard deviation of 15, the proportion of people with IQs above 130 is: (95% / 68% / 5% / 2.5%)

If the standard deviation of population 1 is 3 with sample size 8 and the population 2 standard deviation is 5 with sample size 7 then the standard deviation of sampling distribution is ______. (4.044 / 3.044 / 1.044 / 2.044)
The discrete variables and continuous variables are two types of ______. (open end classification / time series classification / qualitative classification / quantitative classification)
If A and B are two mutually exclusive events with P(A) > 0 and P(B) > 0 then it implies they are also independent. (True / False)
Failing to reject the null hypothesis when it is false is: ______. (alpha / Type I error / beta / Type II error)
If the standard deviation of the population is 35 and the sample size is 9 then the standard deviation of sampling distribution is ______. (11.67 / 13.67 / 14.67 / 12.67)
If A and B are two mutually exclusive events with P(~A) = 5/6 and P(B) = 1/3 then P(A/~B) is equal to ______. (1/4 / 1/2 / 0, since mutually exclusive / 5/18)
The median, mode, deciles and percentiles are all considered as measures of ______. (mathematical averages / population averages / sample averages / averages of position)
In binomial probability distribution, the dependents of standard deviations must include ______. (probability of q / probability of p / trials / all of above)
The diagrams used to represent grouped and ungrouped data is classified as ______. (breadth diagrams / bar diagrams / width diagrams / length diagrams)

A problem in mathematics is given to three students A, B and C. If the probability of A solving the problem is 1/2 and B not solving it is 1/4. The whole probability of the problem being solved is 63/64 then what is the probability of solving it? (as printed) (1/8 / 1/64 / 7/8 / 1/2)
The number of observations are 30 and the value of arithmetic mean is 15 then sum of all values is ______. (15 / 450 / 200 / 45)
In stem and leaf display diagrams used in exploratory analysis, the stems are considered as ______. (central digits / trailing digits / leading digits / dispersed digits)
If (AB) < (A)(B)/N then the association between two attributes A and B is ______. (Symmetrical / Negative / Zero / Positive)
Randomly assigning treatment to experimental units allows: (population inference / causal inference / both types of inference / neither type of inference)
